# Carnegie Mellon University
> Carnegie Mellon University is a private global research university known for leading programs in computer science, engineering, arts, business and interdisciplinary innovation.

Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) serves students, researchers, faculty, alumni and partners through academic programs, admissions resources, research centers, campus life information, news, libraries and administrative services. Its web presence spans undergraduate and graduate education, world-renowned AI and robotics research, and school-specific sites across the university.

## University Overview
- [About Carnegie Mellon](https://www.cmu.edu/about): Overview of CMU’s mission, identity, history and institutional profile.
- [Leadership](https://www.cmu.edu/leadership): University leadership, president, trustees and strategic institutional priorities.
- [Vision, Mission & Values](https://www.cmu.edu/about/vision-mission-values): Official statements describing CMU’s purpose, principles and goals.
- [History](https://www.cmu.edu/about/history): Historical background from Carnegie Technical Schools to modern CMU.
- [Traditions](https://www.cmu.edu/about/traditions): Campus traditions, symbols and longstanding university customs.
- [Rankings & Awards](https://www.cmu.edu/about/rankings-and-awards): Selected rankings, honors and institutional recognitions.
- [Strategic Framework](https://www.cmu.edu/strategic-framework/): University-wide strategic priorities and long-term planning framework.
- [Global Locations](https://www.cmu.edu/global): Information about CMU’s international campuses and global presence.

## Academics
- [Academics at CMU](https://www.cmu.edu/academics): Central hub for academic offerings, schools and interdisciplinary study.
- [Schools & Colleges](https://www.cmu.edu/academics#paragraph-2016): Links to CMU’s colleges, schools and academic units.
- [Interdisciplinary Programs](https://www.cmu.edu/academics/interdisciplinary-programs): Programs spanning multiple disciplines and collaborative areas of study.
- [Undergraduate Majors & Programs](https://www.cmu.edu/admission/majors-programs): Undergraduate majors, minors and academic program options for applicants.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.cmu.edu/graduate/prospective/index.html): Graduate and professional program information for prospective students.
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.cmu.edu/hub/calendar/): Official academic calendar with semesters, breaks and key dates.
- [The HUB](https://www.cmu.edu/hub/): Student services for registration, billing, financial aid and records.
- [University Libraries](https://www.library.cmu.edu/): Library services, collections, research support and digital scholarship resources.

## Admissions & Enrollment
- [Undergraduate Admission](https://www.cmu.edu/admission/): Undergraduate admissions requirements, deadlines and application guidance.
- [Majors & Programs](https://www.cmu.edu/admission/majors-programs): Explore undergraduate academic pathways available to applicants.
- [Costs & Affordability](https://www.cmu.edu/admission/cost-and-aid): Tuition, aid and affordability information for undergraduates.
- [Graduate Admission](https://www.cmu.edu/graduate/): Graduate admissions overview and links to school-specific programs.
- [Graduate Prospective Students](https://www.cmu.edu/graduate/prospective/index.html): Resources for prospective graduate and professional students.
- [International Admission](https://www.cmu.edu/admission/admission/international-admission): Admissions guidance for international undergraduate applicants.
- [Visit CMU](https://www.cmu.edu/visit/): Campus tours, visitor information and admissions visit planning.
- [Student Financial Services](https://www.cmu.edu/sfs/): Billing, payments, financial aid and student account services.

## Research
- [Research at CMU](https://www.cmu.edu/research/): University research overview, initiatives, support and impact areas.
- [Research That Moves the World Forward](https://www.cmu.edu/research): Entry point to CMU’s research strengths and priorities.
- [The Birthplace of AI](https://www.cmu.edu/ai/): CMU’s artificial intelligence leadership, history and current initiatives.
- [Robotics Institute](https://www.ri.cmu.edu/): Research, education and projects in robotics and autonomous systems.
- [Software Engineering Institute](https://www.sei.cmu.edu/): Federally funded research center for software, cybersecurity and AI engineering.
- [CyLab Security and Privacy Institute](https://www.cylab.cmu.edu/): Research and education in cybersecurity, privacy and digital trust.
- [Scott Institute for Energy Innovation](https://www.cmu.edu/energy/): Energy and climate research, policy and technology initiatives.
- [Engineering Research Accelerator](https://www.cmu.edu/engineering/research/): Research programs and innovation activity within the College of Engineering.

## Schools & Colleges
- [College of Engineering](https://www.cmu.edu/engineering/): Engineering education, research, departments and innovation programs.
- [School of Computer Science](https://www.cs.cmu.edu/): Computer science programs, departments, research and faculty.
- [Tepper School of Business](https://www.cmu.edu/tepper/): Business education, MBA programs, research and analytics leadership.
- [Dietrich College of Humanities and Social Sciences](https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/): Programs in humanities, social sciences and interdisciplinary scholarship.
- [Mellon College of Science](https://www.cmu.edu/mcs/): Science departments, research and undergraduate and graduate education.
- [College of Fine Arts](https://www.cmu.edu/cfa/): Architecture, art, design, drama and music programs.
- [Heinz College](https://www.heinz.cmu.edu/): Public policy, information systems and management education.
- [School of Drama](https://www.drama.cmu.edu/): Conservatory drama training, productions and admissions information.

## Student Life & Campus
- [Current Students](https://www.cmu.edu/current-students): Central resources for enrolled students and campus services.
- [Campus Life](https://www.cmu.edu/campus-life/): Housing, dining, wellness, activities and student experience resources.
- [Living in Pittsburgh](https://www.cmu.edu/campus-life/living-in-pittsburgh): Information about neighborhoods, transportation and city life.
- [Student Affairs](https://www.cmu.edu/student-affairs/): Student support, engagement, wellness and campus life offices.
- [Housing Services](https://www.cmu.edu/housing/): On-campus housing options, assignments and residential information.
- [Dining Services](https://apps.studentaffairs.cmu.edu/dining/conceptinfo/): Dining locations, meal plans and campus food services.
- [Health Services](https://www.cmu.edu/health-services/): Medical care, immunizations and student health resources.
- [Career & Professional Development Center](https://www.cmu.edu/career/): Career advising, recruiting and internship and job search support.

## Faculty, Staff & Administration
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.cmu.edu/faculty-staff): Resources and services for employees and faculty members.
- [Human Resources](https://www.cmu.edu/hr/): Employment, benefits, policies and workplace resources.
- [Office Directory](https://www.cmu.edu/directory-contact): Directory and contact information for university offices.
- [CMU Directory](https://directory.andrew.cmu.edu/): Searchable directory for people, departments and contact details.
- [Computing Services](https://www.cmu.edu/computing/): IT services, accounts, security and technology support.
- [Finance Division](https://www.cmu.edu/finance/): Financial operations, procurement and administrative finance resources.
- [University Policies](https://www.cmu.edu/policies/): Official institutional policies, standards and compliance guidance.
- [Provost](https://www.cmu.edu/provost/): Academic leadership, faculty affairs and educational strategy.

## News, Events & Communications
- [CMU News](https://www.cmu.edu/news/): Official university news, research stories and announcements.
- [Featured News](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/): Curated stories highlighting major university developments.
- [Events Calendar](https://www.cmu.edu/events/): Public events, lectures, performances and campus happenings.
- [News Archive](https://www.cmu.edu/news/archive/): Archived university news releases and past stories.
- [University Communications & Marketing](https://www.cmu.edu/marcom/): Brand, media relations and communications resources.
- [CMU Magazine](https://magazine.cmu.edu/): Alumni and university magazine featuring stories and profiles.
- [Social Media Directory](https://www.cmu.edu/social/): Official university social media channels and accounts.

## Alumni, Giving & Engagement
- [Alumni Association](https://www.cmu.edu/engage/alumni/): Alumni programs, benefits, events and volunteer opportunities.
- [Engage with CMU](https://www.cmu.edu/engage/): Alumni, donor and community engagement opportunities.
- [Give to CMU](https://givenow.cmu.edu/campaigns/42524/donations/new?a=8338674): Official giving page for donations and philanthropic support.

- [CMU Magazine](https://magazine.cmu.edu/): University magazine with alumni-focused stories and updates.

## Global & Community Impact
- [Global Locations](https://www.cmu.edu/global): International campuses, programs and partnerships worldwide.
- [CMU in Qatar](https://www.qatar.cmu.edu/): Undergraduate programs and campus life at CMU-Q.
- [Africa Engineering Technology Network](https://www.africa.engineering.cmu.edu/): CMU Africa programs in engineering and technology education.
- [Community Engagement](https://www.cmu.edu/community-engagement/): Partnerships and initiatives connecting CMU with surrounding communities.
- [Sustainability Initiative](https://www.cmu.edu/sustainability/): Campus sustainability goals, programs and environmental efforts.
- [Center for Shared Prosperity](https://www.cmu.edu/sharedprosperity/): Research and partnerships focused on inclusive regional growth.
- [Living in Pittsburgh](https://www.cmu.edu/campus-life/living-in-pittsburgh): Local context for students, families and visitors in Pittsburgh.
